entities.name: Precinct Two
entities.description: A precinct of the Tenth District of Ravnica City, a district of modest homes and honest work with quiet tension between law officers and crime families.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: A district of Ravnica City that contains Precinct Two and its airship hub.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild of law and order, whose guildhall New Prahv stands in Precinct Two and employs many locals.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild of soldiers; active soldiers and veterans settle in Precinct Two.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild of finance and religion, which holds a discreet foothold in Precinct Two through business ties and protection rackets.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The main guildhall of the Azorius Senate and the district's tallest landmark, with three immense columns.

entities.name: Griffin Heights
entities.description: A hilly southern neighborhood of Precinct Two known for two-story homes and underground dealings with the Orzhov.

entities.name: Augustin Station
entities.description: The main airship hub for the Tenth District, at the west end of Griffin Heights.

entities.name: Udzec, the Monolith
entities.description: A maximum security prison run by the Azorius.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin who staged a riot at Sawtooth Prison and escaped while being transferred to Udzec.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who turned Isperia to stone at the Azorius Senate House.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius leader turned to stone by Vraska.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war in which the Azorius Senate House hosted several transguilt meetings.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A famed Boros officer who upheld the Guildpact during the Decamillennial Celebration; a statue of him stands in Whitestone.

events.summary: Vraska turned Isperia to stone at the Azorius Senate House.
events.quote: This was where Vraska turned Isperia to stone.

events.summary: Krenko staged a riot at Sawtooth Prison, then staged an escape while being transferred to Udzec.
events.quote: Krenko was being transferred here from Sawtooth Prison in Precinct Four after he staged a riot, but staged an escape during the transfer.

events.summary: The Azorius Senate House hosted several of the transguilt meetings during the War of the Spark.
events.quote: Hosted several of the transguilt meetings during the War of the Spark .
